context.transcript:
Remember that our annual building inspection will take place this Friday.
Before you leave on Thursday, please make sure all documents are locked in your desk drawers to help protect our client-related information.
Speaking of clients, several clients have requested that we be on call to answer questions in the evenings.
We will be implementing that for select clients next month.
Evening work hours will be discussed at next week's meeting.
context.transcript_translation:
请记住我们的年度建筑检查将于本周五举行。
在周四离开之前，请确保所有文件都锁在您的抽屉里，以帮助保护我们与客户相关的资料。
说到客户，几位客户要求我们在晚上待命回答问题。
下个月我们将为特定客户实施这项服务。
晚间工作时间将在下周的会议上讨论。
